title: Kichamani M.B.A.
overview: Kichamani a smooth talking wheeler-dealer who runs a big establishment specialized in bribing officials and making things done from government machinery. Kichamani has his own reasons to think that the remedy for corruption is not anti corruption, but corruption itself.
